credits.title: The Child
credits.overview: The story of Mariaje and Nicasio, the mother and grandfather of one of the children who died in a gas explosion in a town in the Basque Country in October 1980. On a journey marked by unexpected emotions, Mariaje and Nicasio search for - and find - their own unique way to overcome their loss.

credits.title: Another Man
credits.overview: Marc and Eudald have been in a stable relationship for six years. Their life seems to run smoothly but even though together they make a good team, Eudald’s increasing impatience to cement their relationship is starting to get to to Marc, who finds himself caught in an emotional deadlock.

credits.title: The Last Romantics
credits.overview: A blue collar worker finds an opportunity after a labor dispute breaks out at her paper mill.
